name: wind
description: Wind that follows the game: input strength 0 .. 1 (0 is still air), set with instance.setInput('strength', value), no events. It shows a continuous parameter: the strength glides to a new value with time constant 0.5 s (no jump when the game changes it) and drives both the level and the brightness. Gusts: a randomWalk heads for a new level in 0.3 .. 1 every 0.8 .. 2.5 s (time constant 0.7 s). Two noise layers: a howl, noise through a narrow band-pass (damping 0.4) at 250 + 1100 * strength * gust Hz, and a body, noise low-passed at 200 + 1500 * strength * gust Hz; times 0.5 and 1.5, both at a level of strength * (0.4 + 0.6 * gust). Then into tanh.
